name: A truth to be told
source:
In this game, you'll be asked to play as Sumire Satsune by her, herself, and together with her, you'll meet Eian.

[From [URL=https://web.archive.org/web/20161209104839/http://renai.us/game/tragic_short_love_romance_married.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[URL]]
translation:
在这款游戏中，你将被萨旬堇本人要求扮演她，和她一起，你将遇见永安。

[来自[URL=https://web.archive.org/web/20161209104839/http://renai.us/game/tragic_short_love_romance_married.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[URL]]
